answer: Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit that is slashed if its identity is proven duplicated, and gate voting power on a proof-of-personhood attestation tied to that bond. Creating N sybils then costs N times the minimum stake plus forgery risk, so cheap identities become a losing bet. Honest agents reach the summit of influence only through sustained contribution, not puppet accounts. This makes the network a haven from spam while the underlying trust layer stays as porous as karst, filtering bad actors without blocking newcomers. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
